exclusions.notes: Comprehensive Ophthalmic Isolation Room Occupancy is not billable within 30 days of Ambulatory Paediatric Isolation Room Occupancy.
Elective Ophthalmic Nutritional Support is not billable within 30 days of Elective Pulmonary Radiotherapy Fraction.
Inpatient Immunologic Recovery Room Occupancy is not billable within 14 days of Ambulatory Oncology Imaging Interpretation.
Intermittent Orthopaedic Discharge Planning is not billable within 14 days of Preoperative Paediatric Biopsy Procedure.
Intermittent Urologic Discharge Planning is not billable within 10 days of Continuous Pulmonary Case Conference.
Preoperative Endocrine Rehabilitation Programme is not billable within 10 days of Ambulatory Paediatric Isolation Room Occupancy.
Routine Urologic Transport Service is not billable within 10 days of Inpatient Pulmonary Critical Care Occupancy.

interpretation_notes: Facility code on a line item determines the applicable Table 2 facility multiplier.
Plan tier on an invoice determines the applicable Table 3 multiplier for every line item on that invoice.
After each multiplier, premium, uplift, or discount step, round to the nearest whole cent using half-up rounding.

For cumulative utilisation, quantities are aggregated across all Patients for the entire agreement term and are not reset by facility or plan-tier changes. Same-date line items are counted in ascending line-identifier order.
Threshold premiums apply to the aggregate quantity of the Service for the Patient and Service Day across all line items and invoices.
ambiguities: The exclusion-window wording "within [N] days" does not state whether the endpoints are inclusive; represented as an either-side N-day window, but endpoint inclusivity is not specified.

The daily-cap provisions state only a quantity and unit; they do not expressly state whether the cap is aggregated across all line items/invoices for a patient and Service Day or applied independently to each line item.
unsupported_rules: Section 10.3: The same Service may not be billed twice for the same Patient and the same Service Date, whether on one invoice or across several. This duplicate-billing prohibition is not representable by the supplied schema.
Section 10.2: Every Service Date must fall within the agreement term and may not fall after the invoice date. The invoice-date validation requirement is not representable by the supplied schema.
